sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The prior instruction remains valid: the unknown branch still requires the propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard QuantityValue in rev/min independently of the Table 6-9 lookup case, so an unrelated quantity can pass. Locate or supply a canonical result/attribution path from the hasTableLookupCase/tableLookupCase node to the resulting rotational-speed quantity, then constrain that linked result in the unknown branch.
